localChanges: A city whose stored shields already cover what it's building no longer offers to buy it at a negative price, which added gold and threw away the extra shields (closes #817).

log: With more shields stored than the item costs, the Spend rules priced it from a negative `remaining()`, so Buy was offered at a negative price (civ-clone/web-renderer#817). They now give no price then. v474.05 offers a $0 purchase in that case, which cuts the stored shields back to the cost; offering nothing keeps the surplus.
CI also checks the committed JavaScript matches the source, as core-treasury's does (civ-clone/web-renderer#66).

PlayerTreasury#buy refused only when the treasury couldn't afford the price. With more shields stored than the item costs, a rule pricing from `remaining()` gives a negative price, and buying added gold and cut the stored shields back to the cost (civ-clone/web-renderer#817). It now does nothing when no shields remain, and never buys at a negative price, whatever the rules say.
Also drops package-lock.json, as for the other engine repositories (civ-clone/web-renderer#66).
